The '''Security S-5''' was a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] produced by [[Theed Arms/Legends|Theed Arms]] for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. This weapon was commonly used by members of the [[Security Officer]] Corps.

==Description==
The S-5 heavy blaster pistol was a versatile weapon with a heavy wooden gripstock and twin scopes for sighting and rangefinding. Unlike most handheld blaster weapons, the S-5 fired green blaster bolts, similar to the [[Q2 hold-out blaster]] pistol. The S-5 also featured a dart launcher underneath the main [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], able to fire either an anesthetic microdart, a sting charge, or a grappling hook tip. The latter was used in conjunction with a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|liquid-cable shooter attachment]]; a quick customization that turned the S-5 pistol into a durable [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension gun]] (as an ascension gun, the S-5's liquid-cable could hold up to 500 kilograms). The cable reservoir held enough liquid to form twenty meters of cable, and the [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|spike launcher]] itself cost around 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==History==
[[File:TyphoBlaster-SWE.png|thumb|left|180px|Naboo officer's pistol variation]]
The S-5 blaster pistol was used extensively during the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] carried one such weapon during the fighting, though other members of the Royal Security Force wielded Naboo officer's pistols, a variation on the S-5 design. Panaka's nephew, [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], carried one of these weapons while serving as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] bodyguard. The expensive, prestige [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] design was later seen in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in the hands of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bardan Jusik]] during an [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|anti-terrorist operation]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' sourcebook erroneously claims the S-5 was manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].
